name: SDF Depth Buffer Integration
aliases: Sphere Tracing with Depth Buffer Output
definition: Writes the correct depth value to `SV_Depth` so ray-marched surfaces participate in the depth buffer and occlude other geometry.
summary: SDF Depth Buffer Integration extends sphere tracing by writing computed hit depths to the hardware buffer, ensuring correct occlusion between ray-marched SDF geometry and standard rasterized geometry.
